_comment: Description pairs whose TF-IDF similarity is above the threshold on purpose. Each entry names what tells the two apart in their descriptions; re-check that reason whenever either description changes. evals/descriptions/run.py reports an entry as stale once its pair scores more than 0.05 below the threshold.

pairs.reason: both write living docs: generate creates them when a service has none; upgrade promotes a verified or merged change into existing docs and closes the spec
chained on purpose for bug fixes (the router emits both): systematic-debugging finds the root cause, test-driven-development governs the failing test before the production edit
aidlc runs every stage and starts with spec; both take a request or a pasted to-spec spec. aidlc says whole lifecycle and resume by slug; spec says stage 1 and ends at accepted.
consecutive steps around a merge: ship opens the PR and reaches shipped (merge on request); upgrade-service-docs runs after the merge and moves the spec to implemented.
